_default.notes: Default tier for any account not explicitly listed below. This is expected, not a gap — only special-cased accounts go in this file; everything else inherits this default. Change the `tier` value here if you want a different fleet-wide default (e.g., `paid` if most Method customers are paid-tier). User counts are queried live via scripts/account_impact.py — do NOT store seat counts here. The bot must NEVER write to this file.
